slots.title: July housing starts 1.239M miss 1.35M estimate
slots.body:
July housing starts: 1.239M vs 1.35M expected (prior 1.415M). Starts fell 12.4% month over month; the consensus was -4.7%, after June’s +19.7%. That’s the count of new homes where ground broke—one of the first reads on how much builders are adding supply.  
Coverage tied the miss to muted builder sentiment after a stretch of soft demand data.

slots.body:
Atlanta Fed GDPNow for Q3: 4% vs 4.3% expected, previous 4.3%. GDPNow is a model-based snapshot of gross domestic product—the broad measure of everything the U.S. economy produces—updated as fresh data arrive.  
Today’s housing starts print (1.239M vs 1.35M expected) was one of the inputs traders were weighing alongside the GDP tracker.
